speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The history of recent levofloxacin use for community-acquired pneumonia combined with frequent watery diarrhea and abdominal cramping is highly suspicious for antibiotic-associated *Clostridioides difficile* infection. Have you experienced any fever, and have you noticed any signs of dehydration such as dizziness or dry mouth?
